window.speaker: HENRI
lines: Away from the window. The road has eyes this morning.

found.speaker: HENRI
lines: They found your parachute before dawn. In Bertrand's beet field, half a kilometre from where you came down.

seen.speaker: MARGUERITE
lines: They are asking at the doors. Someone told them a man walked away from it.

seen2.speaker: HENRI
lines: So they will come here too. Today, perhaps. You will be a wall away from them, and you will be nothing — no sound, no breath.

not_seen.speaker: HENRI
lines: The wreck burned all night. For now they think the crew burned with it. Let them think it.

plan.speaker: HENRI
lines: Tonight a man comes for you. You go with him and you do not ask his name. What he does has a price higher than ours.

choices.text: Thank you. For all of it.
Why risk this? If they catch you—
I should go now. Alone. Before they come.

thanks.speaker: MARGUERITE
lines: Thank the saints when you are home, not us. Sit. There is bread.

why.speaker: HENRI
lines: I know what they do to us either way. That is why. Sit. There is bread.

alone.speaker: HENRI
lines: You would be dead before the church. A tall man in flying boots, walking the Route Nationale. Sit down.

luc.speaker: LUC
lines: Is it true the fortress carries thirteen guns? Michel says only ten—

wait.speaker: HENRI
lines: Eat. Then you wait, away from the window, and you listen for me.
